title: Supported dimensions
content_data:
A dimension is an attribute to group your data by. DSA reports support the following dimensions. Please note that currently, we don't support all dimensions available on TikTok Ads Manager. # For Catalog Ads > **Note**
> When you run DSA reports for Catalog Ads (formerly known as Video Shopping Ads with product source as catalog), only the asynchronous mode is supported. ## Supported dimensions ```xtable | Dimension Name{20%} | Description {80%} | |---|---|---| | advertiser_id | Group by Advertiser ID. | | campaign_id | Group by Campaign ID.| | adgroup_id | Group by Ad Group ID.| | ad_id_v2 | Group by Ad ID.

The types of data you can get include:
  • the ad level data for Manual Ads
  • the ad level data for Smart+ Campaigns
  • the ad (asset group) level data for Upgraded Smart+ Ads

Note:

  • You cannot use it together with the dimension `ad_id`, the filter `ad_ids`, or the attribute metric `ad_id`.
| | ad_id | Group by Ad ID.

The types of data you can get include:
  • the ad level data for Manual Ads
  • the ad level data for Smart+ Campaigns
  • the creative level data for Upgraded Smart+ Ads
| | stat_time_day | Group by day. | | catalog_id_v2 | Group by Catalog ID | | product_id_v2 | Group by Catalog product ID. | | sku_id_v2| Group by SKU ID.| | brand | Group by Brand.

Note:

  • See the “Dimension grouping” section below to learn about the supported dimension grouping.
  • This dimension is supported at all levels (`data_level` = `AUCTION_CAMPAIGN`, `AUCTION_ADGROUP`, `AUCTION_AD`, or `AUCTION_ADVERTISER`).
  • The supported metrics for this dimension are:
    • `offline_shopping_events`
    • `value_per_offline_shopping_event`
    • `offline_shopping_events_value`
    • `total_purchase_value`
    • `total_complete_payment_rate`
    • `conversion`
| | content_category | Group by Content Category.

Note:

  • See the “Dimension grouping” section below to learn about the supported dimension grouping.
  • This dimension is supported at all levels (`data_level` = `AUCTION_CAMPAIGN`, `AUCTION_ADGROUP`, `AUCTION_AD`, or `AUCTION_ADVERTISER`).
  • The supported metrics for this dimension are:
    • `offline_shopping_events`
    • `value_per_offline_shopping_event`
    • `offline_shopping_events_value`
    • `total_purchase_value`
    • `total_complete_payment_rate`
    • `conversion`
| ``` ## Dimension grouping The supported dimensions are categorized as ID, time, DSA, and Brand dimensions. - ID Dimensions：`advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, `ad_id` - Time Dimensions: `stat_time_day` - DSA Dimensions: `catalog_id_v2`, `product_id_v2`, `sku_id_v2` - Brand Dimensions: `brand`, `content_category`. In your request, if no Brand dimension is used, you should at least have one DSA dimension. ID and time dimensions are optional: - One or more DSA dimensions (required) + single ID dimension (optional) + single time dimension (optional) If you want to use a Brand dimension, ensure that your dimension grouping meets the following requirement: - One Brand dimension (required) + single DSA dimension (optional) + single ID dimension (optional) + single time dimension (optional) > **Note**
> The maximum number of dimensions you can use in one single request is four. Using too many dimensions may result in longer processing times. # For Dynamic Showcase Ads ## Supported dimensions ```xtable | Dimension Name{20%} | Description {80%} | |---|---|---| | advertiser_id | Group by Advertiser ID | | campaign_id | Group by Campaign ID

Note: By default the `campaign_status` filter is applied and defaults to `STATUS_NOT_DELETE` in synchronous DSA reports. If you want to get breakdown data for all campaigns including the deleted ones via synchronous DSA reports, you need to set `campaign_status` to `STATUS_ALL`. | | adgroup_id | Group by Ad Group ID

Note: By default the `adgroup_status` filter is applied and defaults to `STATUS_NOT_DELETE` in synchronous DSA reports. If you want to get breakdown data for all ad groups including the deleted ones via synchronous DSA reports, you need to set `adgroup_status` to `STATUS_ALL`.| | ad_id | Group by Ad ID

Note: By default the `ad_status` filter is applied and defaults to `STATUS_NOT_DELETE` in synchronous DSA reports. If you want to get breakdown data for all ads including the deleted ones via synchronous DSA reports, you need to set `ad_status` to `STATUS_ALL`. | | stat_time_day | Group by day | | catalog_id | Group by Catalog ID | | product_set_id | Group by Product Set ID | | product_id | Group by Product ID | |sku_id| Group by SKU ID| ``` ## Dimension grouping The supported dimensions are categorized as ID, time and DSA dimensions. - ID Dimensions：`advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, `ad_id` - Time Dimensions: `stat_time_day` - DSA Dimensions: `catalog_id`, `product_set_id`, `product_id`, `sku_id` In your request, you should at least have one DSA dimension. ID and time dimensions are optional. - Multiple DSA dimensions (required) + single ID dimension (optional) + single time dimension (optional) > **Note**
For the DSA dimension, `product_set_id` must not be used with `product_id` or `sku_id`.
